name: YFG Liquid Strokes [Flux | Krea]
description: YFG Liquid Strokes: Surreal Painterly Transformations Elevate your creations with YFG Liquid Strokes , a LoRA that imbues images with fluid, dynamic brushwork reminiscent of traditional painting techniques. This model is flexible across a wide range of strengths, offering anything from a subtle artistic flare to bold, surreal transformations. Key Features Painterly Brushwork Adds fluid, organic strokes to any scene, delivering a hand-painted feel. Visually softens edges while introducing rich textures and vibrant layering. Wide Strength Range Works effectively from 0.5 (mild effect) to 2.0 (extreme surrealism). Retains coherence even at higher strengths, though the style grows increasingly surreal. 1.5 strength is a sweet spot for a strong painterly transformation without losing subject clarity. Most users prefer 0.8 – 1.0 for a balanced, artistic look. Responsive to Keywords Incorporating terms like “painting,” “illustration,” “drawing,” or “brush strokes” guides the LoRA toward more refined painterly outcomes. Without direction, it may default to fiery or skeletal imagery—so well-defined prompts yield the best results. Recommended Usage Trigger / Prompt Word Use “YFG-Liqd” to activate the liquid, painterly aesthetic in your scenes. LoRA Strength 0.5 : Subtle artistic accent 1.0 : Balanced painterly effect 1.5 - 2.0 : Striking surrealism with fluid distortion and vivid textures Suggested Themes & Keywords “Painting,” “brush strokes,” “canvas texture,” “vibrant illustration,” etc. Pair with your main subject (character, landscape, object) to evoke a captivating, painted style. Tips & Tricks Directing the Theme If you don’t want unintentional fire or skeleton elements, specify your subject clearly— e.g., “portrait of a woman in a flowing gown, YFG-Liqd style” . Lighting & Color Because of its painterly nature, colorful or high-contrast prompts produce especially dramatic results. Try “sunset lighting,” “rainbow palette,” or “pastel watercolor” for diverse effects. Combine With Other LoRAs YFG Liquid Strokes can blend well with additional style or subject LoRAs, overlaying its painterly effect onto various settings, eras, or thematic elements. YFG Liquid Strokes beautifully blends digital artistry with traditional brushwork aesthetics, giving your creations a lush, painterly essence at almost any strength level. Perfect for conceptual art, surreal illustrations, or simply adding a fresh, fluid dimension to your images.
